dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: You're giving me that look that says, "Who's this pint-sized pipsqueak half the height of his own sword telling me he's some sort of hero!" Don't even try to deny it.

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Hmph! With this sword from the blacksmith, I ain't scared of anyone!

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Once I get my Geo Vision, I'm gonna be the most legendary hero this world's ever seen!

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Do I really need to spell it out?

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: With the power of Geo in my hands, I could conjure up a giant stone pillar beneath my feet!

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Then everyone would have to look up to me, mwuhahaha...
